criteria.criterion: The page's Start here section and transition cards state what a newcomer needs and the current page omits or blurs. This includes the failure and limit behaviour already in the claims: lock contention exits 1 without waiting, an unreadable capacity exits 1, relaunch failure restores the record, no retry or relaunch bound was found, and a missing session start leaves a close unreplayed. It also corrects the over-simplified merge-authority wording, since yolo is a configured setting and the claim says the 'configured merge authority', and the glossary entry for 'ship'.

The walkthrough adds relaunch-failure restore (c19) and no replay without a session start. Summaries t2, t5, t6, t7 and t8 add the same points. The merge-authority text now reads 'configured merge authority; with yolo off, the captain approves every PR merge and local-only landing', in the what entry, walkthrough, t3 and the glossary entries for yolo and captain. The 'ship' entry is rewritten from c10, c12 and c18.

findings.summary: The verifier changed its snapshot, which invalidates its verdict
The glossary entry for 'exit 1' says more than its claims support
findings.evidence: The entry says 'The exit status of a refused spawn: the project lock could not be taken, or the capacity declaration was unreadable.' A reader would take this to mean every refused spawn exits 1 and only for those two reasons. The cited claims c4 and c7 support only those two cases. Other refusals, such as c1 (no backlog item) and c2 (held or blocked item), have no exit code in the claims.

findings.summary: The change summary does not give the source path and lines for each correction
findings.evidence: The CHANGELOG entry names the corrections but says only that statements 'cite existing claims'. It gives no firstmate path or line for each one, which criterion 1 asks the change summary to include. The producer's separate summary was not visible to me.

findings.summary: No fresh reading of the pinned source; only existing claims were brought onto the page
findings.evidence: claims.json, model.json, rationales.json and findings.json are unchanged. The reviewers said the page gets facts wrong or leaves them out. Any of those that are not already covered by c1–c22 would remain. I could not check this because firstmate's source is not in the snapshot.

findings.summary: The captain is called 'the person', which no claim states
findings.evidence: Claim c11 names only 'the captain' and does not say the captain is a person.

summary: The change fixes the explainer page and does what the request asks. The intro, walkthrough, transition summaries and glossary now cover the failure and limit behaviour that was already in the study's claims: lock contention and an unreadable capacity both exit 1, a failed relaunch restores the prior record, no retry or relaunch bound was found, and a close is not replayed without a session start. They also correct the merge-authority wording and the 'ship' entry. The renderer now shows a guard of 'none' as "No guard applies." instead of naming the placeholder agent evaluator, and a new test covers this. Every new statement cites existing claims c1–c22, and none of those claims were changed. I built the page with `cargo run -p xtask -- site --out verify-site-out`: it exited 0, wrote index.html, and cards t5, t7 and t8 show "No guard applies." `cargo test --workspace`, clippy and `cargo fmt --check` all pass. Every changed file is on the expected-deliverables list, and no governance file changed. Remaining issues are minor: the glossary entry for 'exit 1' says more than its claims support; the CHANGELOG entry does not give source paths and lines; and I could not check the quotes against firstmate's source because the snapshot does not include it. The change only brings existing claims onto the page. It adds no new claims from a fresh reading of the pinned commit, so any errors the reviewers found outside the current claims would still be there.
